title: Non-Atomic Compare-And-Swap Loop
pattern: Reading a lock flag and setting it in distinct, non-atomic steps in a concurrent context.
why_bad: High-risk race condition. Multiple threads can check `busy` simultaneously, see `false`, and concurrent executions will enter the critical section.
detection: Sequential read and write operations on shared flags in thread-spanning functions without synchronization.
source: Maurice Herlihy, *Monitors and Blocking Synchronization*, Chapter 17.
